steps.text: add-Extract and add contents of an egg to a microwave-safe bowl
visible_evidence: Hands cracking an egg shell over a bowl
Raw egg white and yolk dropping into a microwave-safe bowl
Raw egg resting inside the bowl

checks.text: The egg contents are inside a microwave-safe bowl
The bowl contains only the liquid egg white and yolk with clean separation from the shell

visible_evidence: Whisk or fork stirring rapidly in the bowl
Egg yolk and white blended into a uniform yellow liquid

checks.text: The egg yolk and white are fully combined into a uniform yellow mixture

steps.text: Place-Place 8 inch tortilla on a cutting board
visible_evidence: Hand laying a tortilla onto a cutting board
Flat tortilla resting on the cutting board

checks.text: The tortilla lies flat on top of the cutting board

steps.text: Microwave-Microwave for 3 minutes, stirring in between
visible_evidence: Bowl placed inside microwave with door closed
Bowl removed midway and egg stirred with a utensil
Cooked and solidified egg visible in the bowl after microwaving

checks.text: The bowl is microwaved for 3 minutes
The egg is stirred midway through microwaving
The egg is fully cooked and solidified after microwaving

steps.text: Add-Add 1/2 tbsp sweet and sour sauce to the bowl
visible_evidence: Measuring spoon filled with sweet and sour sauce
Sweet and sour sauce poured into the bowl with the egg

checks.text: Sweet and sour sauce is added directly into the bowl with the egg

visible_evidence: Hand shaking oregano container or pinching oregano over the bowl
Green oregano flakes visible on top of the egg in the bowl

checks.text: Oregano is sprinkled over the contents of the bowl

steps.text: Add-Add 1 tbsp salsa to the bowl
visible_evidence: Measuring spoon scooping salsa
Salsa deposited into the bowl with the egg

checks.text: Salsa is added directly into the bowl with the egg

steps.text: Mix-Mix the contents of the bowl well
visible_evidence: Utensil stirring the egg, sauce, oregano, and salsa in the bowl
Evenly coated and blended egg mixture inside the bowl

checks.text: The egg, sweet and sour sauce, oregano, and salsa are thoroughly combined in the bowl

steps.text: Pour-Pour egg mixture on top of the tortilla
visible_evidence: Bowl tilted over the tortilla on the cutting board
Egg mixture resting on top of the tortilla

checks.text: The egg mixture is transferred from the bowl onto the tortilla

steps.text: Sprinkle-Sprinkle 1 tbsp shredded cheddar cheese on top of the egg
visible_evidence: Measuring spoon or hand scattering shredded cheddar cheese
Shredded cheddar cheese visible on top of the egg mixture on the tortilla

checks.text: Shredded cheddar cheese is distributed on top of the egg mixture

steps.text: Roll-Roll the tortilla from one end to another into a log shape, about 1.5 inches thick. Roll it tight enough to prevent gaps but not so tight that the filling leaks
visible_evidence: Hands rolling the tortilla from one edge to the opposite edge
Rolled cylindrical tortilla log resting on the cutting board

checks.text: The tortilla is rolled from one end to the other into a cylindrical log shape about 1.5 inches thick
The rolled tortilla is snug with closed layers and all filling contained inside
